package task

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// UpdateTaskInput holds updated fields.
type UpdateTaskInput struct {
	ID                     string
	Title                  string
	Description            string
	Translations           []domain.TaskI18n
	LearningTargets        *[]domain.TaskLearningTarget
	CodeStructure          []byte
	ComposeConfig          *[]byte
	Type                   *string
	AssessmentPurpose      *string
	ExecutionMode          *string
	EvaluationMode         *string
	UIMode                 *string
	SubmissionMode         *string
	RequiresSandbox        *bool
	ExposesPreview         *bool
	ExposesTerminal        *bool
	SupportsLiveValidation *bool
	AllowedErrorsCount     *int
	Order                  int
	Status                 int
	Tests                  []domain.TaskTest
	StarterFiles           *[]domain.TaskFileStorage
	MaxAttempts            *int
}

// UpdateTask updates stored task.
type UpdateTask struct {
	Tasks           repository.TaskRepository
	Lessons         repository.LessonRepository
	TaskI18n        repository.TaskI18nRepository
	TaskTests       repository.TaskTestRepository
	TaskFiles       repository.TaskFileStorageRepository
	LearningTargets repository.TaskLearningTargetRepository
	Publisher       domain.EventPublisher
	ComposeConfigs  repository.ComposeConfigRepository
	StructureRes    repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
	Tx              repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle updates task entity.
func (uc UpdateTask) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateTaskInput) (*domain.Task, error) {
	var normalizedLearningTargets []domain.TaskLearningTarget
	if in.LearningTargets != nil {
		var err error
		normalizedLearningTargets, err = domain.NormalizeTaskLearningTargets(*in.LearningTargets)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	var task *domain.Task
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		var err error
		task, err = uc.Tasks.Get(ctx, in.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		translations := normalizeTranslations(in.Translations)
		if len(translations) == 0 {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		task.Title = translations[0].Title
		task.Description = translations[0].Description

		nextType := task.Type
		if task.AssessmentPurpose == "" {
			task.AssessmentPurpose = domain.AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck
		}
		if in.AssessmentPurpose != nil {
			purpose, purposeErr := domain.NormalizeAssessmentPurpose(*in.AssessmentPurpose)
			if purposeErr != nil {
				return purposeErr
			}
			task.AssessmentPurpose = purpose
		}
		if parsedType, err := requestedTaskTypeCode(in.Type); err != nil {
			return err
		} else if parsedType != 0 {
			nextType = parsedType
		}
		if task.Status == domain.TaskStatusActive && nextType != task.Type {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: cannot change task type while task is active", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		isAssessmentTask := domain.IsAssessmentTaskType(nextType)
		assessmentKind := domain.TaskAssessmentKind(nextType)
		if task.AssessmentPurpose == domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic && !isAssessmentTask {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if domain.IsAssessmentTaskType(task.Type) && nextType != task.Type {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}

		if isAssessmentTask {
			allowedErrorsCount := task.AllowedErrorsCount
			if in.AllowedErrorsCount != nil {
				allowedErrorsCount = *in.AllowedErrorsCount
			}
			if err := normalizeTaskTestSourceKeys(in.Tests, assessmentKind); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := domain.ValidateTaskAssessments(in.Tests, allowedErrorsCount, assessmentKind); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			structureType, err := uc.StructureRes.GetByCode(ctx, domain.TaskAssessmentCodeStructureType(nextType))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			task.CodeStructureTypeID = structureType.ID
			task.CodeStructure = domain.DefaultTaskAssessmentCodeStructure(assessmentKind)
			task.ComposeConfig = nil
			task.ComposeConfigID = nil
			task.AllowedErrorsCount = allowedErrorsCount
		} else {
			if strings.TrimSpace(task.CodeStructureTypeID) == "" {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if len(in.Tests) > 0 {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if len(bytes.TrimSpace(in.CodeStructure)) == 0 {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(nextType, in.CodeStructure); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			task.CodeStructure = in.CodeStructure
			task.AllowedErrorsCount = 0
		}

		if in.ComposeConfig != nil && !isAssessmentTask {
			composeConfig := bytes.TrimSpace(*in.ComposeConfig)
			if len(composeConfig) == 0 {
				task.ComposeConfig = nil
			} else {
				task.ComposeConfig = composeConfig
			}
			task.ComposeConfigID = nil
			if len(composeConfig) > 0 && uc.ComposeConfigs != nil {
				existing, err := uc.ComposeConfigs.GetByConfig(ctx, composeConfig)
				if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
					return err
				}
				if existing != nil {
					task.ComposeConfigID = &existing.ID
				} else {
					title, description := domain.DeriveComposeConfigMeta(composeConfig)
					config := domain.ComposeConfig{
						ID:          uuid.NewString(),
						Title:       &title,
						Description: &description,
						Config:      composeConfig,
						CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
					}
					if err := uc.ComposeConfigs.Create(ctx, config); err != nil {
						return err
					}
					task.ComposeConfigID = &config.ID
				}
			}
		}
		task.Order = in.Order
		if in.MaxAttempts != nil {
			task.MaxAttempts = in.MaxAttempts
		}
		caps, err := domain.MergeTaskCapabilities(*task, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{
			Type:                   in.Type,
			ExecutionMode:          in.ExecutionMode,
			EvaluationMode:         in.EvaluationMode,
			UIMode:                 in.UIMode,
			SubmissionMode:         in.SubmissionMode,
			RequiresSandbox:        in.RequiresSandbox,
			ExposesPreview:         in.ExposesPreview,
			ExposesTerminal:        in.ExposesTerminal,
			SupportsLiveValidation: in.SupportsLiveValidation,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := domain.ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability(task.CodeStructure, caps.SupportsLiveValidation); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		domain.ApplyTaskCapabilities(task, caps)
		if err := validateSandboxRuntime(ctx, uc.Lessons, task); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if task.Status == domain.TaskStatusActive && in.Status == domain.TaskStatusNoActive && uc.Lessons != nil {
			parentLesson, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, task.LessonID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if parentLesson.Status == domain.LessonStatusActive {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: cannot deactivate task while parent lesson is active", domain.ErrValidation)
			}
		}
		task.Status = in.Status
		task.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
		if err := uc.Tasks.Update(ctx, *task); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if in.LearningTargets != nil {
			if uc.LearningTargets == nil {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
			for index := range normalizedLearningTargets {
				normalizedLearningTargets[index].TaskID = task.ID
			}
			if err := uc.LearningTargets.ReplaceForTask(ctx, task.ID, normalizedLearningTargets); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if uc.TaskTests != nil {
			var tests []domain.TaskTest
			if isAssessmentTask {
				tests = prepareTaskTests(task.ID, in.Tests)
			}
			if err := uc.TaskTests.ReplaceForTask(ctx, task.ID, tests); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if uc.TaskFiles != nil && in.StarterFiles != nil {
			if err := uc.TaskFiles.ReplaceForTask(ctx, task.ID, normalizeTaskStarterFiles(task.ID, *in.StarterFiles)); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}

		if uc.TaskI18n != nil {
			for _, translation := range translations {
				translation.TaskID = task.ID
				if err := uc.TaskI18n.Upsert(ctx, translation); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}

		// Reload persisted task to return fresh translations (with language metadata).
		refreshed, err := uc.Tasks.Get(ctx, in.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		task = refreshed
		if uc.LearningTargets != nil {
			task.LearningTargets, err = uc.LearningTargets.ListByTask(ctx, task.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(ctx, domain.SubjectTaskUpdated, map[string]any{"task_id": task.ID})
	return task, nil
}
